name: remix-db-migrations-deno
description: Run @remix-run/data-table migrations from Deno with the Remix v3 CLI: remix.json db config, timestamped up.sql/down.sql directories, deno task wiring, Turso/libSQL via a runRemixDb() entry point, and the Deno-specific traps (unversioned npm:remix is Remix v2, node:sqlite works but pg/mysql2 must be added).
